scope: Proposition 6.1 (Eight-block Fourier bound) of the manuscript “Optimal-order mixing of the Thorp shuffle” (preprints/Optimal-order-mixing-of-the-Thorp-shuffle-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b02c5b13a61d6c0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n be a positive multiple of eight, and partition the labels of G = Sn into sets M1, . . . , M8 of size n/8. For each a, let Ha be the subgroup fixing every label outside Ma. Suppose a probability measure ν on G satisfies ν(gHa) ≤ 4 |Ha| |G| (g ∈ G, 1 ≤ a ≤ 8). Then every irreducible unitary representation ρ of G, of degree D, satisfies ∥b ν(ρ)∥op ≤ AD−5/16 , A = p 32C1. (6.3)
